title: Pix fraud marker registration failure
description: Pix fraud marker integrity registration failure. The following endpoints generate this event: Create fraud marker. For more information, see the Pix instant payments guide. Also see the Pix payments data events guide.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Key used to guarantee data Idempotency.

document_number.title: Document Number
document_number.description: A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil). Must be numeric with 11-14 digits.

key.title: Pix key
key.description: Key to which the fraud marker will be associated. It must be reported, if known.

error_message.title: Error message.
error_message.description: Error message that occurred during processing in the integrity stream.
